question: Find the display name of the owner of the post that has the highest total number of votes among all posts whose titles contain 'data visualization', and also report how many comments that post has received.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS comment_count
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
LEFT JOIN comments c ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
WHERE p."XCL_035" LIKE '%data visualization%'
GROUP BY p."XCL_026", u."XCL_055"
ORDER BY COUNT(v."XCL_066") DESC
LIMIT 1;
